_comment: Atlas Growth :: home additions RECOVERY pass over excluded_officp.csv (RUN-NOTES STEP 5b step 2). The main config's allow-list drops any row with no remodel/GC/builder google_type. This pass takes those rows back ONLY when the business NAME says the trade — the type+name pairing qualify-leads.js cannot express as one rule. Addition builders typed bare 'Contractor', 'Carpenter', 'Building firm', 'Garage builder', 'Handyman' come back here. Deterministic, $0, no re-scrape. Recovered rows are routed to the site-text gate like every other row. No review floor here on purpose (IMPROVEMENTS 2026-09-20: a floor inside a name-gated recovery only strands rows).

qualify_rules._r: Scope: only rows the main allow rule dropped (not_in_icp). A row a primary-type deny or the name deny dropped (roofer, landscaper, pool builder, big box, civic) stays dropped even when its name says 'construction' — those rules saw it (dry-run 2026-10-11: 'Sunshine Roofing & Construction' leaked back without this).
qualify_rules.label: not_allow_drop

qualify_rules._r: Generic types an addition builder gets typed as. Deny-listed primaries never reach this file with the allow label, so no venue term is needed here.
qualify_rules.label: not_generic_contractor

qualify_rules._r: The name must claim the trade. Multi-letter stems only (substring trap): 'addition' also matches 'additions'; 'renovat' matches renovation/renovations/renovators.
qualify_rules.label: name_not_addition
